name: project-tracker
description: 为跨多次会话的长期任务在 .claude/project/<slug>/ 建立可恢复、可审计的档案（charter/plan/state/journal/decisions），新会话冷启动时用 5 行汇报恢复上下文。Use when a task spans multiple sessions and its goal, plan, state and decisions must survive between them.

interface.longDescription: Keeps a per-project archive (charter, plan, state, append-only journal and ADRs) under .claude/project/<slug>/ so that a fresh session with no context can resume long-horizon work from a five-line brief, and every result, dead end and decision is checkpointed with evidence.
defaultPrompt: 继续上次的项目，我们做到哪了？
